name: avenger
description: Ant-colony market research: Stark is the only driver -- it dispatches the core three research lines in parallel (market / users / open-source), may wake the optional lines (tech / compliance / money), adversarially reviews every report and closes with a go/no-go judgment, then merges everything into docs/sop/avenger_<slug>.md

actions.message:
Topic: {{topic}}

FIRST write the deliverable. Call md_file with action=write, path=docs/sop/avenger-<slug>.md. The file MUST open with a one-page SUMMARY of at most 60 lines: (1) verdict - go / go-small / no-go, with one line of why; (2) the entry point and the wedge to attack first; (3) build vs reuse, layer by layer; (4) the top five risks or blind spots that remain unproven, each marked; (5) the cheapest next step that would settle the biggest unknown. Only after that summary come the per-line details. If the file exceeds 8KB, continue with action=append chunks until every section is on disk, then read the tail of the file back with read_file(start_line=...) to prove the summary survived. Call md_file with action=write, path=docs/sop/avenger-<slug>.md, content=<the full consolidated Markdown>; if it exceeds 8KB, continue with action=append chunks until every section is on disk. Then call write_avenger_doc with the same Markdown.

Your judgment line from the last review round (may be empty if you converged in round 1):
{{judgment.prev}}

Write the FINAL consolidated research report as ONE Markdown document, merging the line reports you have in this session (and read docs/sop/avenger_<slug>_*.md with file_requests if you need the details back):
1. Verdict: go / no-go / go-small, and why (3-5 bullets)
2. Entry point and the wedge you would attack first
3. Build vs reuse: what to write yourself, what to take from open source
4. Risks and blind spots that remain unproven (mark them)
5. Evidence table: conclusion | source grade | confidence | source
6. One condensed section per research line (its own summary + unknowns)
Then call write_avenger_doc with the full Markdown. Do not reply only DONE.
